name: guardian_xql_templates
description: Ready-made XQL queries for GuardianXQL: who changed a resource, who only read it, what an identity or an IP did, which permissions an identity never used. Each has placeholders filled from checked arguments. The model may still write raw XQL with xdr-xql-generic-query; these only make the common questions easy. Add a template here without changing any script.
data: {"version": 1, "templates": [{"name": "identity_activity", "dataset": "cloud_audit_logs", "params": ["identity"], "default_hours": 6, "max_hours": 72, "description": "What one identity did in the cloud audit log: operations, outcomes, source IPs and networks, user agents and resources, grouped by operation. Pass a user principal name (alice@example.test), an object id, or a DOMAIN\\account (matched by the account name before the @ across all domains). Use it to see the session around an alert and to spot sign-in failures, IAM changes and new source networks.", "query": "dataset = cloud_audit_logs | filter (lowercase(identity_name) = \"{identity_lc}\" or lowercase(identity_uuid) = \"{identity_lc}\") | comp count() as events, values(caller_ip) as ips, values(caller_ip_asn_org) as asns, values(user_agent) as agents, values(referenced_resource_name) as resources, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by operation_name, operation_status, cloud_provider | sort desc events | limit 50", "account_query": "dataset = cloud_audit_logs | filter arrayindex(split(lowercase(identity_name), \"@\"), 0) = \"{account}\" | comp count() as events, values(caller_ip) as ips, values(caller_ip_asn_org) as asns, values(user_agent) as agents, values(referenced_resource_name) as resources, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by operation_name, operation_status, cloud_provider | sort desc events | limit 50"}, {"name": "resource_change_history", "dataset": "cloud_audit_logs", "params": ["resource"], "default_hours": 72, "max_hours": 720, "description": "Who changed one cloud resource and when: state-changing operations on it, newest first, with the identity and source IP. Use it for a misconfiguration whose change was recent.", "query": "dataset = cloud_audit_logs | filter (lowercase(referenced_resource) = \"{resource_lc}\" or lowercase(referenced_resource_name) = \"{resource_lc}\") and state_changing_event = \"true\" | fields _time, identity_name, identity_type, operation_name, operation_status, caller_ip | sort desc _time | limit 50"}, {"name": "resource_access_activity", "dataset": "cloud_audit_logs", "params": ["resource"], "default_hours": 24, "max_hours": 168, "description": "Who read or used one cloud resource without changing it: identity, type, operations, source IPs and when, most active first. Use it to see who touched a storage account, key or database that is exposed or was changed.", "query": "dataset = cloud_audit_logs | filter (lowercase(referenced_resource) = \"{resource_lc}\" or lowercase(referenced_resource_name) = \"{resource_lc}\") and (state_changing_event = \"false\" or state_changing_event = null) | comp count() as events, values(operation_name) as operations, values(caller_ip) as ips, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by identity_name, identity_type | sort desc events | limit 50"}, {"name": "ip_activity", "dataset": "cloud_audit_logs", "params": ["ip"], "default_hours": 24, "max_hours": 168, "description": "What one source IP did in the cloud audit log: which identities used it and which operations they ran, with the network owner and country. Use it to judge whether an address is routine for this environment.", "query": "dataset = cloud_audit_logs | filter caller_ip = \"{ip}\" | comp count() as events, values(caller_ip_asn_org) as asns, values(caller_ip_geolocation) as geo, values(user_agent) as agents, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by identity_name, operation_name | sort desc events | limit 50"}, {"name": "identity_unused_permissions", "dataset": "ciem_permissions_with_last_access", "params": ["identity"], "default_hours": 24, "max_hours": 24, "description": "The permissions one identity or compute resource holds, one row each: the action, its access level, whether it is administrative, the resource and service it applies to, the policy that grants it, and last_access_time. An empty last_access_time means never used, unless is_last_access_supported is false, in which case the platform does not track access for that permission.", "query": "dataset = ciem_permissions_with_last_access | filter source_cloud_resource_name contains \"{identity}\" | fields source_cloud_resource_name, source_cloud_resource_type, action_name, action_access_level, action_access_isadministrative, dest_cloud_resource_name, dest_cloud_service_name, grantedby_cloud_policy_name, is_last_access_supported, last_access_time | limit 100"}]}
